documentation.description: Compare an exact MaxSim baseline, raw per-primary-shard MUVERA candidates, and the normal exact-rescored rank_vectors top-k using one point-in-time. This private diagnostic requires allow_exact:true and rejects nested, non-indexed, non-MUVERA, or inconsistent mappings.

index.description: A comma-separated list of index names to evaluate

ignore_unavailable.description: Whether unavailable indices should be ignored

allow_no_indices.description: Whether wildcard expressions may resolve to no indices

expand_wildcards.description: Which concrete indices wildcard expressions expand to

wait_for_completion.description: If false, store the response and return a task identifier

body.description: The field, explicit multivector query_vector, k, num_candidates, and mandatory allow_exact:true.
